items.title: MercoPress: Lost savings and broken trust: life for those hit by Ueno Bank’s closure

items.title: MercoPress: Which Clubs Won the Summer 2026 Transfer Window?
items.content_text: The summer window isn't decided by who makes the biggest signing announcement. By that measure, Chelsea, Tottenham, Real Madrid, AC Milan, and Manchester City have done the most coherent work so far as of August 6, 2026, even though the Premier League window doesn't close until September 1. It's still too early for a final judgment.

items.title: MercoPress: Poverty in Argentina rises to 32.3%, ending two years of decline
items.content_text: Poverty in Argentina reached 32.3% of people in the first half of 2026, an increase of 4.1 percentage points on the second half of 2025, the National Institute of Statistics and Census reported on Thursday.
